note: Machine-readable guardrails, loaded at task start and handed to workers. Small on purpose: this is a checklist that survives between tasks, not a knowledge base. Add a lesson only when getting it wrong cost real time.

lessons.lesson: Never assume browser Web APIs such as URL exist in the n8n Code-node sandbox. Parse with string operations or a documented node helper instead.
Never choose an unpaid order by "latest timestamp" when an authoritative identity or mapping can exist. Resolve by identity (channel + external chat id), not by recency.
Validate the outbound payload shape against the RECEIVING API's contract before publishing anything that sends it.
Production environment and configuration presence is part of feature completeness. Code that is correct and unconfigured is not done.
A workflow reporting "Succeeded" does not prove the business outcome succeeded. Verify the customer-facing effect, not the execution status.
Inspect the existing backend contracts before inventing a new endpoint. The endpoint you need usually already exists under a different name.
Do not discard a worktree merely because a Builder invocation hit error_max_turns. Inspect the diff first — ATLAS-004's interrupted run held the implementation that shipped as f42d5d0.
The repository worker must never bypass AGENTS.md to modify an external system. Route the problem to the worker that owns that system, or stop and ask.
Prefer the smallest isolated change, then verify the NEXT boundary. Guess-change-guess-change is how a two-line bug costs a day.
Do not declare a task done until the original success criteria are proven. Compiled, deployed and "Succeeded" are not the goal.
